# Go IPv6 wire fixtures

`udp.bin` and `ra.bin` were generated by the unchanged `frame.go` and `frame6.go`
code from the repository's `v1.2.0` Go tag. `generate.py` extracts those codecs
to a temporary directory and runs Go there; the old Go tree is not restored.
The small IPv4 helper only satisfies an unused reference in `frame.go`.

The Rust test consumes the UDP fixture through actual ingress and installs the
SLAAC/RIO state from the router advertisement. Both fixtures include transport
checksums computed by Go, independently of the Rust checksum code.
